name: The Depths
author: x-salmon
description: Rewards for levels 21 to 99: lanterns, kraken arms, a lighthouse and a solid gold pedestal for the tank, with glows, currents and halos for him.

decor.name: Lagoon Lantern
decor.description: An old ship lantern that still glows. Nobody refills it. Nobody asks.

decor.name: Kelp Arch
decor.description: Two kelp stalks that met in the middle and decided to stay that way.

decor.name: Tide Clock
decor.description: Keeps perfect tidal time. Ask it the hour and it says "low-ish".

decor.name: Brain Coral
decor.description: Thinks very slowly about very big things. Mostly about sitting there.

decor.name: Sunken Terminal
decor.description: Still waiting for input after forty years underwater. Very patient. Very green.

decor.name: Sea Fan
decor.description: A lace fan for a very large, very damp duchess. She never came back for it.

decor.name: Anglerfish Lamp
decor.description: All teeth and a reading light. He has never once read by it, but he likes the glow.

decor.name: Pearl Oyster
decor.description: Opens up to show off the pearl, then snaps shut the moment anyone gets ideas.

decor.name: Diving Bell
decor.description: A brass bell with a pocket of air inside. Bring a book, it is a long way down.

decor.name: Kraken Arm
decor.description: Only one arm is showing. The other seven are being polite about it.

decor.name: Geode Cluster
decor.description: Plain rock on the outside, a whole purple party on the inside. Relatable.

decor.name: Lightning Jar
decor.description: A storm, caught and corked. It rattles the lid when it wants attention.

decor.name: Shipwreck Mast
decor.description: The rest of the ship is somewhere. The crow's nest is his now, and he keeps watch.

decor.name: Lighthouse Beacon
decor.description: Sweeps the tank all night so no snail ever runs aground. None ever have. You're welcome.

decor.name: Message Buoy
decor.description: Bobs with a bottle tied on. The note inside says "the logs are fine". He wrote it.

decor.name: Sage Scroll
decor.description: Ancient wisdom in a language nobody reads. He nods at it knowingly anyway.

decor.name: Whirlpool
decor.description: A tiny maelstrom with big ambitions. It has swallowed two pebbles and one opinion.

decor.name: Moon Jelly
decor.description: Pulses gently, glows faintly and never, ever hurries. A role model.

decor.name: Wave Crest
decor.description: A wave frozen mid-curl in sea glass. Surf's permanently up.

decor.name: Drowned Bell
decor.description: Rang for a town that sank. Now it rings only when he bonks it, which is often.

decor.name: Sovereign Throne
decor.description: Coral, gold and two very real gems. He sits on it for exactly as long as it takes to feel important.

decor.name: Bioluminescent Garden
decor.description: A whole garden that makes its own light. Nobody here has paid an electric bill in years.

decor.name: Trench Vent
decor.description: A chimney from the bottom of the world. Smells of sulphur and very old secrets.

decor.name: Prism Crystal
decor.description: Splits light into every colour, then splits hairs about which is best.

decor.name: Elder Statue
decor.description: The first crab, carved in stone. His eyes still glow when someone ships on a Friday.

decor.name: World Shell
decor.description: Hold it to your ear and you hear the sea. Look inside and you see all of it.

decor.name: Supreme Pedestal
decor.description: Solid gold, three columns, one ruby. Built for the crab who has done absolutely everything.

effects.name: Bubble Trail
effects.description: A steady string of bubbles. He is definitely up to something.

effects.name: Ripple Step
effects.description: Every step makes a ring. He walks in circles on purpose.

effects.name: Plankton Glow
effects.description: The tiny drifting things have started glowing. He suspects they like him.

effects.name: Ink Puff
effects.description: Startled himself. Left a little cloud behind about it.

effects.name: Deep Sparkle
effects.description: Cold blue glints, the kind you only see far below the light.

effects.name: Pressure Shimmer
effects.description: The water bends around him. Down here, that is a compliment.

effects.name: Amethyst Aura
effects.description: Purple shards circle him like he owns a geode. He owns a geode.

effects.name: Rain Cloud
effects.description: His own personal weather. It only rains when he is thinking about bugs.

effects.name: Beam Sweep
effects.description: Slow lighthouse beams wash over him. Ships stay clear of the keyboard.

effects.name: Ember Float
effects.description: Warm sparks drifting up from the vents. Cosy, in a slightly volcanic way.

effects.name: Rune Glow
effects.description: Old symbols wheel around him. He can't read them, but they clearly rate him.

effects.name: Vortex Idle
effects.description: Stand still long enough and the water starts circling. Mind the snacks.

effects.name: Tidal Wake
effects.description: Little white crests trail behind him like he means business.

effects.name: Abyss Eyes
effects.description: Something in the dark is watching. It seems friendly. Mostly.

effects.name: Crown Glint
effects.description: A ring of tiny golden crowns. Modesty was never really an option.

effects.name: Deep Current
effects.description: A cold current from the trench threads past him, going somewhere important.

effects.name: Prism Trail
effects.description: Rainbow flecks spill off him like light through a crystal.

effects.name: Myth Halo
effects.description: Golden motes circle him slowly. Legends say he earned every one.

effects.name: Countdown Sparks
effects.description: Three, two, one... one level to go. The sparks can't wait either.
